summary.text: Kellie Keenan is the Republican nominee for Rhode Island's 1st District. In her Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey she describes herself as a public health professional, small business owner, wife and mother of three daughters with more than a decade of experience in healthcare and community programs. She is running on infrastructure and permitting reform, community health centers, and housing and energy affordability.

paragraphs.text: Keenan earned a high school diploma from Boston Latin School and an advanced certificate in public health management from Suffolk University.
What's Up Newp reports that she served in AmeriCorps NCCC.

She describes herself as a lifelong New Englander and has worked more than a decade in healthcare and community health operations, including with Community Health Centers and federally funded programs; Ballotpedia lists her career experience as public administration.

According to What's Up Newp, she began her career at a community health center and went on to work in public health operations, including clinical research and leadership roles in medical, behavioral health and dental care.
Keenan describes herself as a wife, mother of three daughters and small business owner who is not a career politician.
She advanced from the September 9, 2026 Republican primary for the 1st District, in which she was the only candidate on the ballot.
